//: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS — do not delete it.
Root vitest (__tests__/**) transforms every file it imports with oxc, and oxc
loads the NEAREST tsconfig.json walking up from the file. For anything under
mobile/src/** that used to be mobile/tsconfig.json, which starts with
"extends": "expo/tsconfig.base" — resolvable only when mobile/node_modules is
installed. CI's `verify` job runs `npm ci` at the REPOSITORY ROOT only, so
there a root test importing mobile source dies with:
[TSCONFIG_ERROR] Failed to load tsconfig for 'mobile/src/...': Tsconfig not found
and it dies ONLY in CI — locally the same test passes for anyone who has run
`npm install` inside mobile/ at some point. That asymmetry burned three
separate pull requests (#697, #700, #701), each of which shipped a green local
gate and a red `verify`.
This config sits between mobile/src and mobile/, resolves with no node_modules
at all, and mirrors the EFFECTIVE options the Expo app compiles with
(expo/tsconfig.base plus mobile/tsconfig.json's own overrides) so the transform
semantics are the same either way. The Expo app itself is unaffected:
`tsc -p mobile/tsconfig.json` and Metro both read the mobile ROOT config, which
still extends the Expo base.
Keep in sync with mobile/tsconfig.json when that file's compilerOptions change.
__tests__/auth/mobile-auth-errors.test.ts is the live consumer — if this file
goes away, that suite fails in CI.
